title: Empowered Skeletons
description: This data pack is hard, I haven't even gotten past the 3rd night without dying. going down caves is VERY hard because of these skeletons
body:
[WARNING]: My pc broke and I no longer have direct access to the files of this data pack, sorry, this is it, I will have to get a nvme to usb c converted so I can get the latest version and upload it

Minecraft Survival is too easy, so this is my take on making it *harder*.

**This is for anyone who wants a hard and annoying challenge, that's REALLY difficult. I recommend this data pack, that replaces every naturally spawning skeleton with special skeletons, that have extremely overpowered items and armor, but killing them give a significant reward if you MANAGE to kill one that is, your best bet is to kill an Asssassin first, it's the weakest. All I can say is good luck to you stranger!**

**There's also a lot of classes, with unique armor trims and stats, and a small bit of lore you can uncover yourself**
 

**Planned Updates:**
- **I will be adding Super Golems, versions of Iron Golems that are way stronger to help defend the world against the evil skeletons, because the Traitor of the World gave the power to skeletons and the Skeletons are the dominating force. Every Skeleton that spawns naturally is VERY powerful.**
- I do plan to rebalance a bit too when I have the time
- I plan to add a command to make the Skeleton Spawning cease or make the skeleton spawning start up again

**Just a quick tip: Every night, a random zombie is selected to be an Extractor Host, and the Extractor host will end up growing some and becoming powerful, at the same time several skeletons will spawn near it, but they can despawn unlike the host, so if you can single out the host and kill it, which is easy even with iron tools, you can obtain it's diamond sword that will help you fight the skeletons**


*If you have any problems feel free to point them out, if you want to make suggestions I have a Discord Server for this*
